operations.name: read_vbe_version
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0x01CE
mov ax, 0
out dx, ax
mov dx, 0x01CF
in ax, dx
movzx eax, ax
ret

operations.name: read_resolution
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0x01CE
mov ax, 1
out dx, ax
mov dx, 0x01CF
in ax, dx
movzx eax, ax
ret

operations.name: set_pixel
operations.desc: Set pixel at (x=10, y=10) to red in 640x480x32bpp mode. Framebuffer at BAR0.
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edi, 0xfd000000
add edi, (10*640+10)*4
mov dword [edi], 0x00FF0000
mov eax, 1
ret
